shell-nav-width-from-wide.$description: The navigation pane's starting width in a window 1440px wide up to 1919px (owner, issue 463 option C, step 2); grid.css sets --plx-sys-shell-nav-width to it there. Under 1440px the width is shell-nav-width.

shell-nav-width-from-1440.$deprecated: Renamed: use --plx-sys-shell-nav-width-from-wide (a name says its step, not its value; docs/adr/0002). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.

shell-nav-width-from-ultrawide.$description: The navigation pane's starting width in a window 1920px wide and wider (owner, issue 463 option C, step 2).

shell-nav-width-from-1920.$deprecated: Renamed: use --plx-sys-shell-nav-width-from-ultrawide (a name says its step, not its value; docs/adr/0002). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.

shell-pane-window-share.$description: The most of the window a pane or a table column may take when dragged (owner, issue 463, option C): 90% of the window for a pane of the shell, of the table for a column, then down to the 4px grid. A smaller limit the app or the component sets still applies.

shell-rail-below.$description: Medium window: the navigation is a rail below this width (Wide from here)

shell-inspector-overlay-below.$description: the inspector collapses and opens over the main region below this width
